# Demo Playwright JavaScript

> A small JavaScript walkthrough demo that uses Playwright to launch Chromium, navigate to testingexamples.github.io, and demonstrate locator strategies and form interactions.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Install and run instructions.
- [Spec](spec/index.md): The exact scenario this demo walks through - target URL, every locator, every form interaction.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Source-of-truth pointer and non-negotiables for agents working on this repo.
- [Citation](CITATION.cff): How to cite this software.

## Source

- [demo.js](src/demo.js): The Playwright walkthrough script itself.

## Optional

- [Live site under test](https://testingexamples.github.io/en-001/practice/): The public page the demo automates.
